novelty_search.nearest_results: On fresh Later/Previously text, block8H1 cue terms causally recover 0.1722/0.1132 and retain 98.2%/96.2% of H1. On discovery text, block9 H1/H4 read the contextualized subject onset. No intervention has selectively blocked that reader interface while actuating the upstream writer.
novelty_search.new_question: Is the fresh block8H1 cue-write effect specifically mediated by block9 H1/H4 reading the two subject-onset states?

population: The same 64 capable fresh Later/Previously A1/A2 rows used for the prospective writer-path screen.

operator.writer: Install donor-minus-base block8H1 temporal-cue source terms at both subject-onset destinations.
operator.reader_bank: At the final semantic query, block9 heads 1 and 4 terms sourced from the two subject-onset positions.
operator.reader_complement: At the same query and heads, every other causal source term from prefix, cue, intervening suffix, and self.
operator.clamp: During the writer-actuated forward, replace the named hybrid block9 H1/H4 source terms by their exact native-base terms; retain the writer, every unclamped head/source term, and the native suffix.

predictions.pred_a_authority_capability_exact_mediat: All authorities and fresh capability hold; source reconstruction is within 5e-4; clamping native base subject-reader terms to themselves changes selected logits by at most 1e-4; every row and arm is finite and complete.
predictions.pred_b_fresh_writer_effect_recurrence: Writer-only recovery remains within 0.03 of 0.1722 in A1 and 0.1132 in A2, with donorward fraction 1.0.
predictions.pred_c_subject_reader_mediates_writer: Clamping the block9 H1/H4 subject-source bank retains at most 0.25 of writer-only mean recovery in both families.
predictions.pred_d_reader_path_is_source_selective: Clamping the reader complement retains at least 0.75 of writer-only recovery, while clamping complete H1/H4 retains at most 0.25, in both families.
predictions.pred_e_exact_zero_fit_price: Exactly 16 model forwards, 512 example evaluations, 256 writer-arm row records plus 64 self-clamp controls, and zero fits/searches/backwards/updates.

terminal.screen: A-E pass. Promote the fresh cue→block8H1→subject bank→block9 H1/H4 path to selective mediation evidence.
terminal.null: The instrument, writer recurrence, and price pass but subject-reader or complement-selectivity mediation fails; retain both identified endpoints without claiming a composed path.
terminal.invalid: Authority, capability, dynamic source capture, reconstruction, self-clamp identity, recurrence, finiteness, coverage, or price fails.

scope: This tests causal composition and selective mediation of the identified writer and reader on fresh text. It does not yet isolate the carried-entry or MLP8 contributions, nor establish unrelated-task collateral preservation.
